notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730989/3effa129ca5a81d1178616801677f7d9bc63e092.gif[/img]

Hello! 
This update includes the following additions:
-A new movement mechanic, the Drop. Double tap slide in the air to drop straight down. 
-The Hammer. A new melee weapon that hit slow but hard. The leftclick attack can be charged to unleash a devastating blow. One of the upgrades for the hammer makes it so that dropping down also does an area attack around you. The hammer is probably overpowered, especially in the early stages, and will be nerfed.
-Trinkets. There is a new dweller in the starting area - a mage that sells trinkets. These can be equipped from the trinket chest. Trinkets are meant to change gameplay in pretty drastic ways and have all sorts of different effects. 


Also, I would like to add that I am extremely grateful for your reviews and engagement in general. I hope that you enjoy this new update. Last update I added a short and simple tutorial. This change was actually bigger than it seemed - I rewrote some parts of the game to be able to handle other levels. Next update you will be able to explore new arenas. 

Thank you and have a nice day ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
This patch adds a short and basic tutorial. Also, the slide upgrade is now available by default.
The "Spend Gold to increase attack speed" upgrade has been rebalanced/fixed. It now only counts gold deposited into the bank, the increase is slightly smaller and is not retroactive in terms of gold spent before the upgrade was applied.
The rest of the patch is bug fixes.

notes.title: Fix Patch
notes.notes:
-Slot Machine has been adjusted
-Archers are less dumb now
-First Boss is not as frustrating (hopefully)

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Everyone! [/b]
First of all, thank you for checking out the game during FPSFest. I really appreciate it!
This update is a little late to the fest unfortunately. 
Biggest addition is the [b]mana system[/b]! The health orb is no longer lonely, it has got a blue friend!
-Dash and Grappling Hook use mana now, so you can't just spam them anymore.
-The Grimoire weapon uses mana as ammo.
-There are a couple new mana-related Upgrades.
Other changes:
-The Jester now offers unique upgrades if you complete his challenge.
-The winter-themed arena is gone, and the green grass is back.
-Enemy health is rebalanced slightly, enemies got steadily stronger with each wave before, now there are additional jumps after each boss wave.
-Bosses have been reworked to be more dynamic and (hopefully) more fun to fight.
And some bugfixes, adjustments and tweaks of course.
Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Localization Patch
notes.notes:
[u][b]Localization Patch[/b][/u]

The first localization has been added - the game is now available in Russian. 
This would have been nice and easy if I hadn't hardcoded every single piece of text to be in English. Now there is a dynamic system and text can be switched between languages freely. Another difficulty I encountered is that translation is difficult, even for a game that is very light on text. Machine translators do a pretty bad job. Which is why there is only one additional language beside English available so far.

[b]Balance / Quality of Life Changes[/b]
-Enemies now flash white on hit and damage number popups appear regardless of how far the hit enemy is. 
-When walking down slopes, the player sticks to the ground now (would go airbourne before and mess up jump timings/was just annoying in general)
-The Grappling Hook has been rebalanced to have a much longer cooldown, which can be shortened with upgrades. Also fixed bug where the Hook would not go on cooldown if the player grappled all the way to the Hook target.
-The Pistol was pretty overpowered and has been rebalanced to have less attack speed.
-Attack speed in general has been nerfed, as it mostly benefited the Pistol.

notes.title: Patch 0.35
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44730989/46778c823b41075942e65b60746405891c8ea2ed.png[/img]

[b]What’s new: [/b]

This patch introduces the first melee weapon of the game - [b]the Sword[/b], which also comes with a set of upgrades. In my opinion, these upgrades are some of the most varied and fun so far (Some of the upgrades are: ability to throw the Sword, option to consume health to enter a frenzy that increases attack- and move-speed, a passive that increases damage when you kill enemies and more)

However, to unlock the Sword you will first have to complete a quest for the new dweller of the castle - the Cursed Swordsman. 

In addition to the Sword upgrades, a couple more general upgrades have been added, mostly to do with gold and enemy drop rate, as gold used to be quite difficult to come by.

A new early game enemy! Actually, it’s the same footman, but with no shield. 

There is now a bell tower in the arena. You can ring the bell by shooting it, which will summon a new wave of enemies (or just sound cool if a wave is already in progress).

Also, a bunch of enemy sound effects have been added, as well as some music.

[b]Changes: [/b]

Besides the new content, there are a few balance changes. The most crucial are:

-Most enemies don’t deal contact damage anymore. Contact damage felt pretty bad, especially with the melee Sword.

-Initial player move speed has been raised. 

-Enemy spawns and health have been rebalanced to be slightly more forgiving.

[b]Fixes: [/b]

Some bug fixes of course. Resolution dropdown in the settings was a little messed up before, now it’s fine. A bunch of typos corrected. Probably a lot more.

notes.title: Winter Patch
notes.notes:
-[b]A new weapon[/b] - the Grimoire! Obtained by completing a short quest for the Shopkeeper.
-The level has been updated with some snow!
-Some waves now come with a new environmental hazard - lava! 
-When one enemy in a wave is left, its location is highlighted by a pointer to avoid having to search for strays.

-Removed the Archer enemy for now, the arrows were too difficult to see.
-Fixed a bunch of bugs.

notes.title: First Content Patch
notes.notes:
First two updates focused on fixing bugs, now it's time for a little bit of new content!
[b]Additions:[/b]
-New enemy type, The archer. 
-New active ability that slows down time. 

[b]Fixes/Changes:[/b]
-improved enemy pathfinding. Still not perfect, they sometimes get stuck, but it is much more performant.
-weapons now don't stutter when moving.
-swapped the sniper rifle and the crossbow as purchasable/available weapons. Now the three originally available weapons aren't all hitscan.
